desc:
An illustration of ballooning, from the Journal des Dames et des Modes, 1797-1798.
The writing on the falling pieces of paper reads: "Rapport sur le premier voyage aërien du Citoyen Garnerin avec la Citoyenne Henri" (Andre-Jacques Garnerin was one of the most famous balloonists of the time).
